Blend Carnival by Blend, Seds & Velocity: Sama’ Abdulhadi (extended set)

Σάββατο 14 Φεβρουαρίου στις 23:00 | Universe - Saturn Area, Λεωφ. Κηφισού 87, Αιγάλεω, Αθήνα, Greece

The bass finds you before the lights do. Universe's Saturn Area opens its industrial expanse for a night that represents carnival season's collision with the heavier end of electronic music. Sama' Abdulhadi's name on the flyer drew everyone here, and the extended set format means she has time to take the room somewhere it doesn't usually go.

Sama' Abdulhadi needs no introduction to anyone who follows the global techno circuit. The Palestinian DJ and producer has earned her position through years of sets that balance power with precision, through releases that proved Ramallah could speak to Berlin. Her extended set tonight — announced as the centerpiece of Blend's carnival programming — represents the opportunity to hear an artist given the time to truly develop an arc.

The Universe crowd on nights like this shows up late and stays later. These aren't casual clubbers who wandered in. You'll find people who've seen Abdulhadi before and came back, alongside those making the pilgrimage for the first time. Carnival costume mixes with standard club black — the music doesn't discriminate. By 3am the room has achieved that rare state where everyone's dancing with everyone, borders dissolved by bass.

Blend's reputation for bringing international talent to Athens finds its annual carnival expression in bookings like this. The extended set format rewards patience — the first hour builds what the third hour releases.

If you need immediate peaks and familiar drops, the extended set pacing will test you. Sama' Abdulhadi uses the extra time to explore rather than repeat. But if you've been waiting for the carnival night where international craft meets local energy, where one of the world's most respected selectors has the hours she needs — Universe's Saturn Area becomes the destination.
